corpus.source: benchmark_writing::corpus::corpus (unchanged writing_quality.json and contextual_quality.json plus authored base rows)

summary.acceptance_rule: All rows complete, exact matched gate, and no observed subject metric excess over its paired fresh A/B floor. Per-row dominance implies no excess in corpus rates or quantiles for the same paired samples; never a fixed epsilon

checkpoint_adoption.scope: Ordinary cache correctness only; no whole-memory checkpoint API invoked

cross_a1_recovery.uncertainty: Descriptive paired corpus differences only; no confidence or power claim. Missing pairs fail rather than being interpreted as zero excess.

cross_a1_rewind.uncertainty: Descriptive paired corpus differences only; no confidence or power claim. Missing pairs fail rather than being interpreted as zero excess.

cross_a2_recovery.uncertainty: Descriptive paired corpus differences only; no confidence or power claim. Missing pairs fail rather than being interpreted as zero excess.

cross_a2_rewind.uncertainty: Descriptive paired corpus differences only; no confidence or power claim. Missing pairs fail rather than being interpreted as zero excess.

summary.paired_unit: One immutable ordinary corpus prompt; A1/B1 and A2/B2 are paired schedule controls; both subjects share those controls
summary.repeats: Two independently destructive-cleared cold observations per schedule; correlated repeats are NOT additional corpus units
summary.same_schedule_floors: Fresh A1/A2 and B1/B2 reported separately, not substituted for fresh cross-schedule A/B calibration

semantic_quality.required_separate_parent_gate: full64 immutable semantic-quality corpus; cap24 cache agreement is not semantic quality

matched_schedule_exact.tolerance: None; f32 to_bits, greedy UTF-8, finish reasons and actual sampler/decode counts exact

summary.uncertainty: Finite authored corpus, one model/backend/context and deterministic seed. No population confidence interval, independence assumption, power claim or nonsignificance acceptance; unseen inputs and run-to-run nondeterminism remain unbounded
summary.work_accounting: Every evaluate and generate call is counted once, including cancelled/error attempts. Clear snapshots contain prior counters and are excluded. Timings are boundary counters, not latency claims.

identity.attention_and_batch_identity_source: Pinned production NativeModel open/decode configuration, not runtime-attested physical-kernel shape

execution_boundary: Frozen original-v19/v22 scratch before the selected published0.5.4 grammar-shortlist integration. This is not a current-primary-sampler, full64 semantic, checkpoint-policy or latency acceptance result.
